“यह बहुत कठिन है,” मेरे सामने बैठे व्यक्ति ने कहा। “हम पचास साल के करीब शादी में रहे हैं, पर मुझे कभी ऐसा कुछ होने की उम्मीद नहीं थी।”

“क्या हो रहा है?” मैंने सहानुभूतिपूर्ण होकर एल से पूछा।

“यह लिसा है,” उसने कहा। “तुम जानते हो कि कुछ समय से उसकी याददाश्त फिसल रही थी। खैर, हमने वही किया जो तुमने कहा था और न्यूरोलॉजिस्ट के पास गए, उन्होंने बहुत सारे टेस्ट और किसी प्रकार का ब्रेन स्कैन किया। फिर उन्होंने कहा कि उसे डिमेंशिया है।”

“मैंने सोचा था कि शायद यही हो रहा है,” मैंने जवाब दिया।

“मुझे पता है कि तुमने हमें यही बताया था,” एल ने कहा। “खैर, ऐसे समय होते हैं जब वह मुझे पहचान नहीं पाती। वह मुझे खाली नजर से देखती है जैसे पूछ रही हो कि उसके घर में कौन सा अजनबी घुस आया है।”

“यह तो बहुत मुश्किल होगा,” मैंने कहा।

“जिस एक चीज़ से मैंने देखा है कि वह वापस अपनी सच्ची स्थिति में आ जाती है, वह है उसे बाहर बुलाकर मोबाइल पर आवाज़ करना। मैं कहता हूँ कि गैरेज में आओ, मुझे तुम्हें कुछ दिखाना है। किसी तरह जब मैं ऐसा करता हूँ, तो वह थोड़ा समय के लिए वर्तमान में लौट आती है और जान पाती है कि मैं कौन हूँ — कम से कम कुछ देर के लिए।”

हम बाद में अन्य बातों पर चले गए, पर मैं देख सकता था कि एल का दिल टूट रहा था। उसकी 48 साल की पत्नी outwardly पहले जैसी दिखती थी और फिर भी, वह पूरी तरह अलग व्यक्ति बन चुकी थी।

मैं डिमेंशिया से निपटने की कुछ चुनौतियों पर विचार करना चाहूँगा।

बाइबल में डिमेंशिया

Ecclesiastes 12:1-7 gives a somewhat dismal view of the aging process. “Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them; While the sun, or the light, or the moon, or the stars, be not darkened, nor the clouds return after the rain: In the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those that look out of the windows be darkened, And the doors shall be shut in the streets, when the sound of the grinding is low, and he shall rise up at the voice of the bird, and all the daughters of musick shall be brought low; Also when they shall be afraid of that which is high, and fears shall be in the way, and the almond tree shall flourish, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail: because man goeth to his long home, and the mourners go about the streets: Or ever the silver cord be loosed, or the golden bowl be broken, or the pitcher be broken at the fountain, or the wheel broken at the cistern. Then shall the dust return to the earth as it was: and the spirit shall return unto God who gave it.”

इस पद में, काव्यात्मक वर्णन दांतों के खोने, सुनने की हानि, अस्थिर चाल और सामान्य नाजुकता के बारे में बोलता हुआ प्रतीत होता है। यह कहना कठिन है कि इन छवियों में से कोई याददाश्त की हानि का संकेत देता है या नहीं। जो निश्चित है, वह यह कि यह पद एक आज्ञा के साथ शुरू होता है: “याद करो!”

यह पवित्र शास्त्र में एकमात्र स्थान नहीं है जहाँ मनुष्यों से याद रखने का आदेश दिया गया है। बार-बार, हमें परमेश्वर को याद रखने के लिए कहा जाता है। हमें यह सुनिश्चित करना है कि हम अपने बच्चों को उसके बारे में सिखाएँ। “And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up” (Deuteronomy 6:7).

ऐसा समय आ सकता है जब हम अब और याद न कर सकें। डिमेंशिया के विषय पर सोचते हुए भी सबसे महत्वपूर्ण बात यह है कि हम उस One को याद रखें जिसने हमें बनाया और पूरे हृदय से उसकी अनुयायी बनें।

डिमेंशिया क्या है

डिमेंशिया कोई भी ऐसी बीमारी है जो स्मृति, तर्कशक्ति और सामाजिक कार्यक्षमता में कमी का कारण बनती है। ज्यादातर लोग मुख्य रूप से स्मृति की हानि के बारे में सोचते हैं। मुझे लगता है कि ऐसा इसलिए है क्योंकि बीमारी की शुरुआती अवस्था में अन्य लोग शब्द ढूँढने में कठिनाई और बार-बार कहानियाँ दोहराने जैसी चीजें नोटिस करते हैं।

सामाजिक कार्यक्षमता अक्सर बीमारी के आखिरी चरण तक बनी रहती है। यदि आप किसी हल्के डिमेंशिया वाले व्यक्ति से आज की तारीख जानते हैं क्या पूछेंगे, तो वे संभवतः कहेंगे, “ओह, तुम जानते हो, मैं रिटायर होने के बाद ऐसी चीज़ों पर ध्यान देना बंद कर दिया।”

डिमेंशिया का सबसे आम कारण अल्जाइमर डिमेंशिया है — कम से कम 70 प्रतिशत लोगों में जिनमें प्रगतिशील स्मृति हानि होती है, उन्हें अल्जाइमर ही होता है। अल्जाइमर शायद अमाइलॉइड नामक प्रोटीन से जुड़ा है, जो मस्तिष्क में जमा हो जाता है और नर्व सेल्स के आपस में संचार करने से रोकता है।

अन्य कारणों में वेस्कुलर डिमेंशिया है, जहाँ मस्तिष्क की रक्त वाहिकाओं में ब्लॉकेज नर्व सेल्स के मरने का कारण बनती है। लेवी बॉडी डिमेंशिया मेमोरी लॉस का वह प्रकार है जो पार्किंसन रोग से जुड़ा होता है। लगभग अस्सी प्रतिशत लोग जिनमें पार्किंसन रोग होता है, अंततः डिमेंशिया विकसित कर लेंगे।

डिमेंशिया का निदान

यदि परिवार के सदस्य संदेह करते हैं कि किसी को स्मृति हानि हो रही है, तो सबसे अच्छा है कि उन्हें मूल्यांकन के लिए उनके प्राथमिक देखभाल प्रदाता के पास ले जाएँ। शारीरिक परीक्षा के साथ, डॉक्टर आम तौर पर रोगी से क्लॉक ड्रॉ करवाने और मिनी मेंटल स्टेटस परीक्षा करवाने जैसी चीजें करवाएगा, जो रोगी से कई सरल प्रश्नों का उत्तर और कुछ अल्पकालिक स्मृति की याददाश्त करवाती है।

रक्त परीक्षणों में थायरॉयड और विटामिन B12 का स्तर शामिल होगा। मस्तिष्क स्कैन या गर्दन की धमनियों का अल्ट्रासोनोग्राफ़ी भी की जा सकती है।

लक्ष्य यह है कि उन क्षेत्रों की पहचान की जाए जिन्हें उपचारयोग्य किया जा सके और उनका ध्यान रखा जाए।

दवाइयों को हटाना

कई दवाइयाँ स्मृति संबंधी समस्याओं का जोखिम बढ़ाती हैं। जैसे-जैसे लोग बूढ़े होते हैं, इन दवाइयों से बचने की कोशिश करना डिमेंशिया के विकास को रोकने में सहायक होता है।

एंटीकॉलीनर्जिक दवाइयाँ शायद सबसे बड़ा अपराधी हैं जिससे मैं मिलता हूँ। इन दवाइयों में सबसे सामान्य पुराने एंटीहिस्टामाइन होते हैं जैसे डिफेनहाइड्रैमिन (जो या तो नींद की गोली या एलर्जी की गोली के रूप में उपयोग होता है) और डोक्सिलैमिन (नींद की गोली के रूप में उपयोग होता है)। एक अध्ययन में, जिन रोगियों ने एंटीकॉलीनर्जिक दवा का तीन साल के समकक्ष उपयोग किया, उनमें उन रोगियों की तुलना में डिमेंशिया का जोखिम काफी अधिक था जिन्होंने ऐसे प्रकार की दवाइयाँ तीन महीने से कम समय के लिए ली थीं.1 पुराने अवसाद विरोधी दवाएँ भी इस श्रेणी में आ सकती हैं।

एंग्जायटी की दवाएँ, जिन्हें बेंजोडायजेपाइंस कहा जाता है, भी स्मृति समस्याओं से जुड़ी हुई पाई गई हैं। अध्ययनों से संकेत मिलता है कि जो रोगी ये दवाएँ लेते हैं उनमें डिमेंशिया विकसित होने का जोखिम उन रोगियों की तुलना में अधिक होता है जो इन्हें नहीं लेते।2

दसनविवेकता दवाइयाँ (seizure medications) भी सोचने की क्षमता को बदतर कर सकती हैं। मिर्गी रोग होने से डिमेंशिया का जोखिम बढ़ता प्रतीत होता है, पर कुछ पुराने दवाएं जैसे वैल्प्रोएट और गैबापेंटिन बुज़ुर्ग लोगों के लिए स्पष्ट रूप से सोचने में कठिनाई बढ़ा सकती हैं, और यदि संभव हो तो बुज़ुर्ग लोगों के लिए कम जोखिम वाली anticonvulsant दवाओं पर शिफ्ट करना उपयुक्त होगा।

ऐसे समय होते हैं जब किसी को दवा लेनी ही पड़ती है, पर जैसे-जैसे रोगी बूढ़े होते हैं, उन दवाओं के जोखिमों के बारे में सोचना महत्वपूर्ण होता है। 65 वर्ष से ऊपर के रोगियों के लिए जिन दवाओं से बचना सबसे बुद्धिमानीपूर्ण होता है उनकी एक सूची है, जिसे बियर्स लिस्ट (Beers List) कहा जाता है। कम दुष्प्रभाव वाली समान दवाओं के स्थान पर बदलना या कम खुराक का उपयोग करना सुझाया जाता है।3

चिकित्सकीय उपचार

डिमेंशिया से निपटने का पहला नियम यह सुनिश्चित करना है कि सभी मेटाबॉलिक चीजें यथासंभव अच्छी नियंत्रण में हों। अतः यदि किसी को मधुमेह है, तो यह सुनिश्चित करना श्रेष्ठ है कि उनका शुगर यथासंभव नियंत्रित हो। यदि किसी को उच्च रक्तचाप है, तो यह सुनिश्चित करें कि वह अच्छी तरह नियंत्रित हो (यह विशेष रूप से सच है यदि किसी को वेस्कुलर डिमेंशिया है)।

डिमेंशिया के इलाज के लिए कई अलग-अलग श्रेणी की दवाइयां स्वीकृत हैं। एक समूह को कोलिनेस्टरase इनहिबिटर्स कहा जाता है। ये दवाइयाँ मस्तिष्क और परिधीय नर्वस सिस्टम में एसिटाइलकोलाइन नामक एक रसायन के स्तर को बढ़ाती हैं। ये दवाइयाँ निश्चित रूप से चमत्कारिक नहीं हैं और अधिकतम ये स्मृति हानि की प्रगति को धीमा करतीं दिखती हैं और वाकई में पिछली मस्तिष्क क्रिया को बहाल नहीं करतीं।

दूसरी दवा मेमान्टिन कहलाती है। यह मस्तिष्क में ग्लूटामेट रिसेप्टर को लक्षित करके काम करती है। कोलिनेस्टरase इनहिबिटर्स की तरह ही, इसके प्रभाव बड़े नहीं होते और अंतिम परिणाम केवल स्मृति हानि को धीमा करना होता है।

ये दोनों दवाइयाँ जेनेरिक हैं, और इन्हें आज़माना और देखना कि कोई व्यक्ति इन पर कैसे प्रतिक्रिया करता है, तर्कसंगत है।

एक आखिरी दवा जिसका उल्लेख किया जाना चाहिए वह लेकानेमैब कहलाती है। यह एक IV इन्फ्यूजन है जो अमाइलॉइड को लक्षित करती है, एक प्रकार का प्रोटीन जो अल्जाइमर डिमेंशिया वाले लोगों के मस्तिष्क में विकसित होता है। यह दवा रोगियों के मस्तिष्क से अमाइलॉइड को साफ़ करने में काफी अच्छी लगती है। यह दवा बहुत महंगी है ($26,500 प्रति वर्ष) और इसे आघात (स्ट्रोक) के बढ़ने से जोड़ा गया है। अध्ययनों में, डिमेंशिया के लक्षण प्लेसिबो की तुलना में केवल लगभग 30 प्रतिशत धीमे हुए थे।

वर्तमान में डिमेंशिया के इलाज के लिए कोई अन्य दवाएं स्वीकृत नहीं हैं।

दवा के बाहर की थेरापियाँ

ऐसी कई चीजें हैं जो लोग डिमेंशिया की प्रगति को धीमा करने के लिए कर सकते हैं। ये उन लोगों के लिए सहायक हो सकती हैं जिनके परिवार में डिमेंशिया का मजबूत इतिहास है और जो इसके आरंभ को रोकना चाहते हैं।

कार्डियोवस्कुलर व्यायाम बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है। डॉक्टर लगभग हर पुरानी बीमारी के संदर्भ में व्यायाम का उल्लेख करते हैं क्योंकि यह प्रभावी साबित हुआ है। डिमेंशिया के मामले में, जो लोग नियमित रूप से व्यायाम करते हैं उनमें बीमारी विकसित होने का जोखिम लगभग 30 प्रतिशत कम होता है। नियमित व्यायाम डिमेंशिया की प्रगति को धीमा करने में सहायक लगता है.4

सुडोकू या क्रॉसवर्ड जैसे मानसिक गतिविधि की आवश्यकता वाले पहेली करने से भी स्मृति हानि की प्रगति धीमी पड़ती दिखती है और डिमेंशिया के विकसित होने की संभावना भी कम हो सकती है।

अंत में, कुछ नया सीखना सहायक होता है। जो लोग कोई नया कौशल सीखते हैं या एक नई भाषा सीखने पर ध्यान केंद्रित करते हैं वे अपनी याददाश्त को काफी हद तक मदद करते हैं। एक अध्ययन में बुज़ुर्ग लोगों की तुलना की गई जिन लोगों ने नया कौशल सीखा था उन लोगों से जो सामाजिक कार्यक्रमों में जाएँ।

मूल बात यह प्रतीत होती है कि हमारे दिमाग को नए मार्ग बनाने के लिए प्रेरित किया जाना चाहिए, अन्यथा वे टूटने लगते हैं।5

डिमेंशिया वाले व्यक्ति की देखभाल

डिमेंशिया वाले व्यक्ति की देखभाल कई तरह से चुनौतीपूर्ण होती है। यह अक्सर जानना मुश्किल होता है कि व्यक्ति को कितनी स्वतंत्रता दी जाए। इस विषय पर कई किताबें लिखी गई हैं, पर कुछ बातें उल्लेखनीय हैं।

खतरनाक चीजों से बचना महत्वपूर्ण है। कमजोर स्मृति वाले किसी व्यक्ति के लिए दो सबसे खतरनाक चीजें ड्राइविंग और खाना पकाना हैं। ये दोनों सामान्य प्रतीत हो सकते हैं, और व्यक्ति ठीक कर रहा हो ऐसा लग सकता है, पर वे बहुत जल्दी समस्या बन सकते हैं।

गाड़ी चलाने के खतरे दो तरह के होते हैं। पहला, कुछ लोग कुछ बिंदुओं पर अटक जाते हैं, किसी खास कौशल को करने का तरीका याद नहीं रहता। यह समस्या केवल उनके लिए नहीं बल्कि सड़क पर दूसरों के लिए भी खतरा बन सकती है।

दूसरा, बुज़ुर्ग लोग छोटी यात्राओं के लिए निकलते हैं जैसे स्थानीय दुकान या रेस्तरां और रास्ता भटक जाते हैं। मेरे कुछ मरीज ऐसे रहे हैं जो शहर की ओर गाड़ी चलाते समय भ्रमित होकर घर लौटने की कोशिश में कई घंटे तक इधर-उधर घूमते रहे।

खाना पकाने का मुद्दा, जाहिर है, ज्यादातर टाइमर सेट करना और उचित समय पर स्टोव या ओवन से चीज़ें निकालना याद रखने का प्रश्न है।

कई बार, डिमेंशिया वाले लोग यह महसूस नहीं करते कि उनकी क्षमताएँ कितनी गिर चुकी हैं और वाहन की चाबियाँ देने के विचार का विरोध करते हैं। शायद यह बस स्वतंत्रता की हानि का प्रश्न है, पर यह स्वीकार करना कठिन होता है कि आप अब स्टियरिंग के पीछे सुरक्षित नहीं हैं।

कक्ष और घर के भीतर चीज़ों को समान रखने की कोशिश करें। कमरे की व्यवस्था में छोटे बदलाव भी स्थिति को बिगाड़ सकते हैं। किसी को उनके घर से बाहर निकालना — उदाहरण के लिए, उन्हें अस्पताल में भर्ती कराना अक्सर चीज़ों को बहुत बदतर बना देता है। अचानक, जो भ्रम पहले केवल हल्का लगता था वह अब अत्यधिक हो जाता है।

यदि किसी फल का नाम दिया जाए तो वह धैर्य है, जो डिमेंशिया वाले व्यक्ति से निपटने के लिए प्रमुख है। हम में से किसी के पास उतना धैर्य नहीं होता जितनी आवश्यकता होती है; जैसे-जैसे डिमेंशिया फैलता है वह हमारे धैर्य को बहुत पतला कर देता है।

डिमेंशिया वाले लोग अक्सर बच्चों की तरह व्यवहार करते हैं जैसे लंबी यात्रा पर हों। वे बार-बार पूछते हैं कि वे कब घर जा रहे हैं। वे मृत रिश्तेदारों के बारे में पूछते हैं या क्यों बच्चे अभी तक घर नहीं आए। कोई भी स्पष्टीकरण मददगार नहीं होता, क्योंकि वह प्रश्न पूछने के एक या दो मिनट बाद वे उत्तर भूल चुके होते हैं और फिर से पूछ रहे होते हैं।

उनकी क्षमताएँ अक्सर उतार-चढ़ाव दिखाती हैं। एक दिन वे अपनी शर्ट के बटन कर सकते हैं, और अगले दिन वह कौशल जैसे उड़ गया हो। यह मानना आसान है कि वे “कठोर प्रयास नहीं कर रहे” और अगर वे प्रयास करेंगे तो वे और अधिक कर सकते हैं।

दुर्भाग्य से, यह तथ्य कि डिमेंशिया वाला व्यक्ति कल कुछ कर सकता था, इसका मतलब यह नहीं है कि वह आज याद रखकर वह कर सकेगा। उनसे गुस्सा होना केवल इन चीज़ों को और बिगाड़ देता है क्योंकि यह उस व्यक्ति में चिंता जोड़ देता है जिसका पहले से ही किसी कौशल को करने की याद कम है।

जहाँ तक संभव हो, व्यक्ति को कोमलता से उत्तर दें भले ही यह आपका पचासवाँ बार हो जब आप वही प्रश्न उत्तर दे रहे हों। ध्यान भटकाने के उपाय भी अपनाएँ। यदि कोई गतिविधि है जिसे वे अभी भी कर सकते हैं, जैसे सिलाई या जिगसॉ पज़ल (यहाँ तक कि बच्चों के बहुत बड़े टुकड़ों वाले पज़ल भी), उन्हें वही करवाएँ। बीमारी के अंत में, उन्हें सुंदर तस्वीरों वाली किताबें दिखाने देना या कभी-कभी उन्हें एक बेबी डॉल पकड़ने के लिए देना उन्हें शान्त कर सकता है और उनके मौजूदा चिंताओं से ध्यान हटा सकता है।

दूसरों से मदद लें

निराश होना आसान है। पूरे के पूरे देखभाल का भार अकेले उठाने की कोशिश करना दीर्घकालिक समाधान नहीं है। डिमेंशिया देखभाल मैराथन है न कि स्प्रिंट। निदान के बाद कई लोग वर्षों तक जीते हैं, और भले ही उनका शारीरिक शरीर अपेक्षाकृत मजबूत रहे, उन्हें अधिक से अधिक देखभाल की आवश्यकता होती है।

परिवारिक संबंधों और चर्च समुदायों का एक आशीर्वाद यह है कि हमारे पास लोग होते हैं जो सहायता प्रदान करने के लिए उपलब्ध होते हैं।

परिवार के सदस्यों या मित्रों को इसमें कदम रखने देना ताकि आपको कुछ आराम मिल सके, गंभीर रूप से जलने या आपके किसी प्रिय व्यक्ति से गुस्सा होने से बचने के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है। यह सबसे अच्छा है कि आप समय-समय पर कुछ समय दूर लें इससे पहले कि आप मानसिक रूप से depleted हो जाएँ। आप सोच सकते हैं कि आप ठीक कर रहे हैं, पर हम सबमें अच्छी तरह काम करने में थकान होने की प्रवृत्ति होती है यदि हमें कभी ब्रेक न मिला हो।

निष्कर्ष

काश डिमेंशिया के लिए अधिक चिकित्सकीय समाधान होते। संभवतः भविष्य में और आएँगे। अभी के लिए, दवाइयाँ काफी सीमित हैं।

मुख्य बात यह है कि आत्मा के फल का अभ्यास किया जाए। “But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, meekness, temperance: against such there is no law” (Galatians 5:22-23).

सबसे निराश करने वाले दिनों पर भी, गंभीर स्मृति हानि से निपट रहे लोगों को उनके परिवार के सदस्यों से प्रेम, कोमलता और धैर्य की आवश्यकता होती है। केवल पवित्र आत्मा की शक्ति के माध्यम से ही हम उस व्यक्ति की आवश्यक देखभाल प्रदान कर सकते हैं जिसका शरीर मजबूत है, पर जो अब आपको पहचान भी नहीं पाता।

A wonderful thing about being a Christian is anticipating the day when we feast our eyes on the magnificent beauty of our God. Quite likely, we have all created mental pictures of what we think God might look like, although we know that our wildest imaginations will be exceeded. “Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off” (Isaiah 33:17). The Bible is full of descriptive word pictures attempting to give us a brief glimpse into the realms of the heavenly. The landscape on the hills of glory, the wonderful creatures that dwell there, and most of all, the Supreme Being on the throne, all defy our human attempt to grasp and understand the beauty and glory of our God.

At times we admire beauty in a song, a work of art, a story, or even another person, but David describes the delight of gazing at the beauty of God. “One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to inquire in his temple” (Psalm 27:4). God is beautiful because His excellence is attractive— His character is flawless. David experienced the pleasure that comes from knowing and experiencing God in all His fullness. How does God express His Beauty?

Through the Gospel

“In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them. For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus' sake. For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ” (2 Corinthians 4:4-6). In the awfulness of the Passion of Christ, we find a profound and sober beauty— the beauty of a sacrifice made by a sinless Savior for undeserving humanity. Sometimes the most stirring kind of beauty is found in things we cannot fully comprehend.

There is beauty in weeping of Mary and the disciples around the cross that held the lifeless body of their beloved Master. But when dawn broke on resurrection morning, despair turned into hope and grief into joy.

We see a beautiful scene at the Mount of Olives forty days later as the same disciples wistfully gazed into the sky, watching as their risen Lord disappeared into the heavens. With great joy, they returned to Jerusalem, with the promise of His return burning in their hearts, to wait for the coming of the Holy Spirit.

Today we expectantly wait for the Son of God to appear from heaven with power and great glory to complete the work of salvation. Then will we look upon Him in all His splendor and beauty. “For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known” (1 Corinthians 13:12).

How should we, as God's image-bearers, reflect His beauty through the Gospel? God is an uncreated eternal being, and man was created in His image to reflect His glory and beauty. However, this beauty has been marred by sin and is no longer a worthy representation of God's character. But, there is redemption! Very little surpasses the beauty of a life that was once bruised and broken by sin but is now restored, redeemed, and made whole by the Gospel. “To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that He might be glorified” (Isaiah 61:3). Atheists challenge the existence of God, scientists argue against Biblical creation, scholars question the inerrancy of scripture, but nobody can dispute the testimony of a redeemed life.

Through Creation

“The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament showeth His handy work” (Psalm 19:1). All beauty in the created world comes from God. A beautiful sunset, a lovely rose, a towering redwood, a majestic mountain peak, all testify of the beauty of God illustrated in creation. As road signs along the highway guide us to our destination, likewise, creation directs mankind to God himself. “For the invisible things of Him from the creation of the world are clearly seen . . .” (Romans 1:20). These gifts of creation are given to give us a brief glimpse of the One who created them.

How should we, as part of God's creation, reflect His creative beauty? Although we cannot make something out of nothing, God has designed us to be creative, using the resources of His creation and our intellectual abilities to make life practical. The fulfilling sense of accomplishment derived from a job well done has its origin in creation, where God regarded His work and declared it to be good. In our attempt to live non-extravagant lives we sometimes fail to take joy in the beautiful things in life. It is right and good and in harmony with how we were created to find pleasure in things of beauty. Ungodly men have used this gift of creativity many times for evil means. So much the more, let us glorify God by using His creation in ways that reflect His character.

A warning for all who love nature and creation (natural and man-made): let us be careful to not elevate earthly beauty above the Creator, which leads to idolatry. Sunsets fade, redwoods tumble, roses wilt, the human body turns to dust again, but God remains. Life and all of its beauty begins and ends with God.

Through Music and Sound

“And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps” (Revelation 14:2) According to the book of Revelation, God's throne is surrounded by sound: thundering and lightning; praises flowing from the angels, the four beasts and twenty elders, and the great multitude which no man can number; and the new song by the one hundred and forty four thousand.

God created the beauty of sound to glorify Himself in ways that mere words cannot. The intricacy of His creativity is powerfully displayed in the way various sound frequencies come together to create a beautiful and heavenly harmony. It is honoring to God for mankind to take pleasure in the beauty of sounds He has created for His glory. The person who loves God will be drawn to Him whenever He is serenaded by pleasing sounds: the people of God singing the songs of Zion, the prayers of the saints, the wind whispering through the treetops, the songbird praising its Maker, the rumble of thunder, or the simple patter of rain on the roof.

How should we, as instruments of sound, reflect God's beauty through sound? We should always seek to listen to and resemble the sounds and harmonies of heaven. Although we will never be able to completely accomplish this on earth, it should be a lifelong endeavor. The questions have been asked,” Should we always be trying to improve our music making?” and “when have we reached ‘good enough’?” We will never be able to attain heavenly perfection, so the question should rather be asked, “Are we giving God the best we have?” Some people have more singing capabilities than others, but the question remains. “Are we giving our best or are we satisfied with an inferior sacrifice?” Let us be producers of God-honoring sounds that bring joy to the heart of the Creator!

Through the Church:

The Bible speaks extensively about the beauty of God's people. “Zion,” “The Temple,” “The Mountain of God,” “Jerusalem,” and“The Church” are synonymous expressions woven throughout scripture referring to the habitation of God's people on the earth. It is God's desire that His beauty would be reflected in the lives of His people. “Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of His holiness. Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King” (Psalm 48:1-2).

Nothing is dearer to the heart of God than His church. When the children of Israel journeyed through the wilderness, they built the tabernacle as a place for God to dwell among them. When Solomon dedicated the temple as God's dwelling place, God was very pleased and 2 Chronicles 7:1 says the glory of the Lord filled the temple. The temple was considered the House of the Lord–Jesus himself referred to it numerous times as God's house and was very passionate that it should be kept holy.

Today, neither the tabernacle nor the temple hosts the presence of God but rather His divine passion is concentrated on the church of Jesus Christ. Here are the people who truly love Him and are willing to lay down their lives for Him. Here are the people who are willing to give up their rights as individuals and surrender themselves to a greater cause. Here is where many a saint has given His very life's blood for the Gospel. And here is where one day our Savior will return as He has promised, and will transport His bride, the church, to her eternal habitation. “And I John saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband. And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be His people, and God Himself shall be with them, and be their God” (Revelation 21:2-3).

How should we, as God's people, reflect His beauty in the church? By dwelling together in unity and harmony with love for all men, especially the household of God. The church should be a place where the world can get a glimpse of what goes on in heaven. It should be a place where Christ is always elevated as the victorious conqueror of sin, death, and hell.

Sadly, many people have become disoriented with the church's failures and have walked away from the true apostolic faith. In spite of our disappointments, let us “lift up the hands which hang down and the feeble knees” (Hebrews 12:12) and let us press on. We will never have a higher calling, and never a more noble warfare to wage.

Lastly, how should we reflect His beauty in our lives? By delighting in Him. “Delight thyself also in the LORD; and He shall give thee the desires of thine heart” (Psalm 37:4). The greatest fulfillment in life comes from finding pleasure in bringing joy to the heart of God by delighting in what He delights in and loving what He loves. Let us never lose the wonder of the beauty of our Salvation!

En underbar sak med att vara kristen är att förvänta den dag då vi får lägga våra ögon på vår Guds magnifika skönhet. Troligen har vi alla skapat mentala bilder av hur vi tror att Gud kan se ut, även om vi vet att våra vildaste föreställningar kommer att överskridas. “Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off” (Isaiah 33:17). Bibeln är full av beskrivande bildspråk som försöker ge oss en kort glimt in i det himmelskas riken. Landskapet på härlighetens kullar, de underbara varelser som bor där, och främst av allt, Den Högste på tronen, trotsar vår mänskliga strävan att greppa och förstå Guds skönhet och härlighet.

Ibland beundrar vi skönhet i en sång, ett konstverk, en berättelse eller till och med i en annan människa, men David beskriver glädjen i att betrakta Guds skönhet. “One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to inquire in his temple” (Psalm 27:4). Gud är vacker därför att Hans excellens är tilldragande—Hans karaktär är felfri. David upplevde njutningen som kommer av att känna och erfara Gud i all Hans fullhet. Hur uttrycker Gud Sin Skönhet?

Genom evangeliet

“In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them. For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus' sake. For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ” (2 Corinthians 4:4-6). I Kristi passions fasor finner vi en djup och dämpad skönhet—skönheten i ett offer gjort av en syndfri Frälsare för ovärdiga människor. Ibland finns den mest gripande typen av skönhet i saker vi inte fullt ut kan begripa.

Det finns skönhet i Marias och lärjungarnas gråt runt korset som bar deras älskade Mästars livlösa kropp. Men när gryningen bröt fram på uppståndelsens morgon förvandlades förtvivlan till hopp och sorg till glädje.

Vi ser en vacker scen på Olivberget fyrtio dagar senare när samma lärjungar med vemod tittade upp mot skyn och såg hur deras uppståndne Herre försvann in i himmelen. Med stor glädje återvände de till Jerusalem, med löftet om Hans återkomst brinnande i deras hjärtan, för att vänta på den helige Andes utgjutelse.

Idag väntar vi förväntansfullt på att Guds Son skall uppenbaras från himlen i kraft och stor härlighet för att fullborda frälsningsverket. Då skall vi se Honom i all Hans prakt och skönhet. “For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known” (1 Corinthians 13:12).

Hur skall vi, som Guds avbildare, reflektera Hans skönhet genom evangeliet? Gud är en oskapad, evig varelse, och människan skapades till Hans avbild för att återspegla Hans härlighet och skönhet. Denna skönhet har dock vanställts av synd och är inte längre en värdig avbild av Guds karaktär. Men det finns förlossning! Mycket få ting överträffar skönheten i ett liv som en gång var sårat och brutet av synd men som nu är återställt, förlossat och gjort helt genom evangeliet. “To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that He might be glorified” (Isaiah 61:3). Atheister ifrågasätter Guds existens, vetenskapsmän argumenterar mot biblisk skapelse, lärde ifrågasätter Skriftens ofelbarhet, men ingen kan bestrida vittnesbördet om ett förlossat liv.

Genom skapelsen

“The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament showeth His handy work” (Psalm 19:1). All skönhet i den skapade världen kommer från Gud. En vacker solnedgång, en älskvärd ros, en ståtliga redwood, ett majestätiskt bergstopp, vittnar alla om Guds skönhet som illustreras i skapelsen. Precis som vägskyltar längs motorvägen leder oss till vår destination, så pekar skapelsen människan mot Gud själv. “For the invisible things of Him from the creation of the world are clearly seen . . .” (Romans 1:20). Dessa skapelsens gåvor ges för att ge oss en kort glimt av Den som skapade dem.

Hur skall vi, som en del av Guds skapelse, spegla Hans skapande skönhet? Även om vi inte kan skapa något ur intet, har Gud utformat oss att vara kreativa, använda resurserna i Hans skapelse och våra intellektuella förmågor för att göra livet praktiskt. Den tillfredsställande känslan av fullbordande efter ett väl utfört arbete har sitt ursprung i skapelsen, där Gud såg på sitt verk och förklarade det gott. I vårt försök att leva icke-utsvävande liv misslyckas vi ibland med att glädjas över livets vackra ting. Det är rätt och gott och i överensstämmelse med hur vi skapades att finna nöje i skönhetens ting. Gudlösa människor har många gånger använt denna gåva av kreativitet till onda ändamål. Därför ännu mer, låt oss prisa Gud genom att använda Hans skapelse på sätt som återspeglar Hans karaktär.

En varning till alla som älskar naturen och skapelsen (både naturlig och människoskapad): låt oss vara försiktiga så att vi inte upphöjer jordisk skönhet över Skaparen, vilket leder till avgudadyrkan. Solnedgångar bleknar, redwood-träd faller, rosor vissnar, människokroppen förvandlas åter till stoft, men Gud förblir. Livet och all dess skönhet börjar och slutar med Gud.

Genom musik och ljud

“And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps” (Revelation 14:2) Enligt Uppenbarelseboken omges Guds tron av ljud: dån och blixt; lovsång flyter från änglarna, de fyra varelserna och de tjugo äldste, och den stora skaran som ingen kan räkna; och den nya sången av de hundrafyrtiofyra tusen.

Gud skapade ljudets skönhet för att prisa Sig själv på sätt som blotta ord inte kan. Hans skaparkrafts invecklade natur visar sig kraftfullt i hur olika ljudfrekvenser samverkar för att skapa en vacker och himmelsk harmoni. Det är en ära inför Gud att människan finner nöje i de ljuds skönhet Han skapat till Sin härlighet. Den som älskar Gud dras till Honom när han blir försjungen i behagliga toner: Guds folk sjungande Sions sånger, de heligas böner, vinden som viskar genom trädtopparna, sångfågeln som prisar sin Skapare, åskans muller eller det enkla smattret av regn på taket.

Hur skall vi, som instrument för ljud, reflektera Guds skönhet genom tonen? Vi bör alltid söka att lyssna till och efterlikna himlens ljud och harmonier. Även om vi aldrig helt kan uppnå detta på jorden, bör det vara en livslång strävan. Frågor har ställts: ”Skall vi alltid försöka förbättra vårt musicerande?” och ”när har vi nått ’tillräckligt bra’?” Vi kommer aldrig att uppnå himmelsk fullkomlighet, så frågan bör istället ställas: ”Ger vi Gud det bästa vi har?” Vissa människor har större sångförmåga än andra, men frågan kvarstår. ”Ger vi vårt bästa eller nöjer vi oss med ett underlägset offer?” Låt oss bli skapare av Gud-äraande ljud som bringar glädje i Skaparens hjärta!

Genom kyrkan:

Bibeln talar utförligt om Guds folks skönhet. “Zion,” ”Templet,” ”Guds berg,” ”Jerusalem,” och ”Kyrkan” är synonyma uttryck vävda genom Skriften som hänvisar till Guds folks boning på jorden. Det är Guds önskan att Hans skönhet skall speglas i Hans folks liv. “Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of His holiness. Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King” (Psalm 48:1-2).

Inget är kärleksfullare för Guds hjärta än Hans kyrka. När Israels barn vandrade genom öknen byggde de tabernaklet som en plats för Gud att bo ibland dem. När Salomo invigde templet som Guds boning var Gud mycket välbehaglig och 2 Chronicles 7:1 säger att Herrens härlighet fyllde templet. Templet betraktades som Herrens Hus–Jesus refererade själv till det många gånger som Guds hus och var mycket passionerad över att det skulle hållas heligt.

Idag är det varken tabernaklet eller templet som hyser Guds närvaro utan snarare är Hans gudomliga passion koncentrerad på Jesu Kristi kyrka. Här är människorna som verkligen älskar Honom och är villiga att lägga ner sina liv för Honom. Här är människor som är villiga att ge upp sina individuella rättigheter och överlämna sig till en större sak. Här är där många en gång gett sitt livs blod för evangeliet. Och här är där vår Frälsare en dag skall återvända såsom Han lovat, och föra Sin brud, kyrkan, till hennes eviga boning. “And I John saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband. And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be His people, and God Himself shall be with them, and be their God” (Revelation 21:2-3).

Hur skall vi, som Guds folk, reflektera Hans skönhet i kyrkan? Genom att bo tillsammans i enhet och harmoni med kärlek till alla människor, särskilt Guds hushåll. Kyrkan bör vara en plats där världen kan få en glimt av vad som pågår i himlen. Den bör vara en plats där Kristus alltid upphöjs som den segerrika härskaren över synd, död och helvetet.

Tragiskt nog har många blivit desorienterade av kyrkans misslyckanden och gått bort från den sanna apostoliska tron. Trots våra besvikelser, låt oss ”lift up the hands which hang down and the feeble knees” (Hebrews 12:12) och låt oss fortsätta framåt. Vi kommer aldrig att ha ett högre kall, och aldrig en mer ärofull kamp att föra.

Slutligen, hur skall vi reflektera Hans skönhet i våra liv? Genom att förtjusta oss i Honom. “Delight thyself also in the LORD; and He shall give thee the desires of thine heart” (Psalm 37:4). Den största uppfyllelsen i livet kommer från att finna nöje i att glädja Guds hjärta genom att förtjusta sig i det Han förtjustar sig i och älska det Han älskar. Låt oss aldrig förlora förundran över skönheten i vår Frälsning!

“Adrianna, what’s the temperature outside?” asked Asher. He and Adrianna were sitting at the table doing school with their siblings Emily and Kianna.

“Probably about 50.” Adrianna glanced lazily at the thermometer. “Hey, it’s 65 degrees! Mom, may we eat lunch outside?”

Mom looked up from the sink. “If you do a good job with your school until then, you may,” she told them. “And if you get your school done before lunch, you may play outside for a while this afternoon.”

Asher let out a whoop and started writing fast. The girls grinned at each other and picked up their pencils.

Everyone worked diligently until lunchtime. Then Adrianna made sandwiches while Asher put cookies in bags, Emily collected bags of chips, and Kianna ran down to the basement to grab a few apples. They each packed their lunch in a shopping bag and went out to their picnic spot, a big, flat rock in a clearing in the woods.

They ate quickly, then Adrianna suggested, “Let’s go kayak on the pond!”

“I guess we could,” said Asher slowly. “But didn’t Mom say that Emily and Kianna are too small to handle the kayaks?”

“Oh, yes, I guess she did. Well, they can play on the swings or something,” she shrugged

“I think we should play something everyone can help with,” said Asher. He turned to Emily and Kianna. “What do you want to do?”

“Let’s make a playhouse!” suggested Kianna.

“Yes, let’s!” Emily agreed. “You could hunt for us,” she told Asher.

“And Adrianna could be the mom!” said Kianna.

Adrianna stood with a scowl on her face. Playhouse indeed! She was way too old for that! “I’m going kayaking,” she announced. “You can just have your playhouse.” She picked up her shopping bag and put her sandwich and cookie bags into it. She threw her apple core to the dogs and started for the house.

“Adrianna, can you please take ours too?” begged Emily. “You're going to the house anyway.”

“You can take care of your own stuff,” Adrianna called back, crossly. She dropped her shopping bag on the counter, hoping to slip out of the house before Mom saw her.

She heard her mom’s voice. “Wait, Adrianna, what’s wrong? Your face looks like a thunderstorm!”

Adrianna sighed. She hadn’t been fast enough. “I wanted to go kayaking, but Asher doesn’t want to,” she grumbled.

“Well,” said Mom slowly, “I think Asher is remembering that the other girls can't handle kayaks yet. What are they doing?”

“They’re building a playhouse. I'm way too old for that!” Adrianna burst out.

Mom smiled, “What makes you think that?”

“I'm sure none of the girls my age do stuff like that with their little siblings.”

“Are you sure you're not being selfish?” Mom asked. “Sometimes, we need to give up what we want so that others can be happy.”

Adrianna shrugged and went out to the shed to get a kayak. She lifted her blue kayak off the rack and hauled it down to the pond. She snapped the paddle together, hopped into the seat, and pushed the kayak onto the smooth surface of the water. She sighed with pleasure. This was way better than building a playhouse in the woods! She took a few loops around the pond before her paddle began to slow. Somehow it wasn’t as fun this time. She heard Asher and the girls laughing and shouting as they played. Maybe Mom was right, she thought. Maybe I would be happier if I gave up what I want so that we can all play together. Slowly she paddled to the edge of the pond. She stepped out of the kayak, pulled it out of the water, and flipped it over to dry. Resolutely, she walked out of the pasture to find Asher and the girls.

“Hey! Here comes Adrianna!” called Emily happily as Adrianna walked up.

Adrianna grinned, “It looks like you have your house about set up,” she said encouragingly. “What do you need to finish it?”

“We still need a stove, and something for a countertop,” said Kianna.

“I can help you find something,” Adrianna told them. Together they hunted in the woods and the shed for boards and logs to finish the house. When suppertime came and they went in for supper, Adrianna was very happy. Mom was right, she thought. It is more fun to give up my way and do what everyone else wants to.

«Adrianna, hva er temperaturen ute?» spurte Asher. Han og Adrianna satt ved bordet og gjorde skolearbeid med søsknene sine, Emily og Kianna.

«Sannsynligvis rundt femti.» Adrianna kastet et dovent blikk på termometeret. «Hei, det er 65 grader! Mamma, kan vi spise lunsj ute?»

Mamma så opp fra vasken. «Hvis dere gjør en god jobb med skolen til da, får dere det,» sa hun. «Og hvis dere blir ferdige med skolen før lunsj, kan dere leke ute en stund i ettermiddag.»

Asher utbrøt et jubelrop og begynte å skrive raskt. Jentene smilte til hverandre og tok opp blyantene.

Alle arbeidet flittig til lunsjtider. Så laget Adrianna smørbrød mens Asher puttet kjeks i poser, Emily samlet poser med chips, og Kianna løp ned i kjelleren for å hente noen epler. De pakket hver sin lunsj i en handlepose og gikk ut til piknikstedet, en stor, flat stein i en lysning i skogen.

De spiste raskt, så foreslo Adrianna: «La oss padle kajakk på dammen!»

«Det kunne vi vel,» sa Asher langsomt. «Men sa ikke mamma at Emily og Kianna er for små til å klare kajakkene?»

«Åh, ja, det sa hun vel. Vel, de kan leke i huskene eller noe,» trakk hun på skuldrene.

«Jeg synes vi bør leke noe alle kan være med på,» sa Asher. Han vendte seg mot Emily og Kianna. «Hva vil dere gjøre?»

«La oss lage et lekehus!» foreslo Kianna.

«Ja, la oss!» sa Emily. «Du kan lete etter ting for oss,» sa hun til Asher.

«Og Adrianna kan være mamma!» sa Kianna.

Adrianna stilte seg med et surt uttrykk. Lekehus, virkelig! Hun var altfor gammel til det! «Jeg skal padle kajakk,» kunngjorde hun. «Dere kan bare ha lekehuset deres.» Hun tok opp handleposen, la smørbrødene og kjeksposene i den. Hun kastet epleskrotten til hundene og gikk mot huset.

«Adrianna, kan du være så snill å ta våre også?» ba Emily. «Du skal jo uansett til huset.»

«Dere kan ta dere av tingene deres selv,» ropte Adrianna tilbake, sint. Hun slapp handleposen på benken i håp om å stikke ut av huset før mamma så henne.

Hun hørte morens stemme. «Vent, Adrianna, hva er galt? Ansiktet ditt ser ut som et tordenvær!»

Adrianna sukket. Hun hadde ikke vært rask nok. «Jeg ville padle kajakk, men Asher vil ikke,» knurret hun.

«Vel,» sa mamma langsomt, «jeg tror Asher husker at de andre jentene ikke kan håndtere kajakkene ennå. Hva driver de med?»

«De bygger et lekehus. Jeg er altfor gammel til det!» utbrøt Adrianna.

Mamma smilte, « Hva får deg til å tro det?»

«Jeg er sikker på at ingen jenter på min alder gjør slike ting med sine små søsken.»

«Er du sikker på at du ikke er egoistisk?» spurte mamma. «Noen ganger må vi gi opp det vi vil for at andre skal bli glade.»

Adrianna trakk på skuldrene og gikk ut til skuret for å hente en kajakk. Hun løftet den blå kajakken av stativet og slepte den ned til dammen. Hun satte sammen pagajen, hoppet i setet og dyttet kajakken ut på det glatte vannet. Hun sukket av fryd. Dette var mye bedre enn å bygge et lekehus i skogen! Hun tok noen runder rundt dammen før padetaket begynte å gå tregere. På en eller annen måte var det ikke så morsomt denne gangen. Hun hørte Asher og jentene le og rope mens de lekte. Kanskje mamma hadde rett, tenkte hun. Kanskje jeg ville være lykkeligere hvis jeg ga opp det jeg vil, så vi alle kan leke sammen. Sakte padlet hun mot kanten av dammen. Hun gikk ut av kajakken, dro den opp av vannet og veltet den for å tørke. Beslutsomt gikk hun ut av beitet for å finne Asher og jentene.

«Hei! Her kommer Adrianna!» ropte Emily fornøyd da Adrianna kom gående.

Adrianna gliste, «Det ser ut som dere har huset nesten ferdig,» sa hun oppmuntrende. «Hva trenger dere for å gjøre det ferdig?»

«Vi trenger fortsatt en ovn, og noe til benkeplate,» sa Kianna.

«Jeg kan hjelpe dere å finne noe,» sa Adrianna til dem. Sammen lette de i skogen og i skuret etter planker og stokker for å fullføre huset. Da det ble tid for kveldsmat og de gikk inn for å spise, var Adrianna veldig glad. Mamma hadde rett, tenkte hun. Det er morsommere å gi opp min måte og gjøre det alle andre vil.

Morals have to do with right and wrong behavior. Purity is being free from moral fault or guilt, marked by chastity, which is personal integrity. Purity contains nothing that does not properly belong there. As the title suggests, this article will be about doing right and being free from moral fault and guilt, living a life of integrity, and keeping our inside and outside free of anything that doesn’t properly belong.

Notice what scripture says about being pure. “Blessed are the pure in heart” (Matthew 5:8). “That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere (pure) and without offense till the day of Christ” (Philippians 1:10). “Think on things that are pure” (Philippians 4:8). “Keep thyself pure” (1Timothy 5:22). Revelation 19 says “The pure in heart shall see God.” Psalm 24:3-4 asks “Who shall see God?” The answer is “he that hath clean hands and a pure heart.” In other words, it is the people who are clean inside and out who will see God and enter His presence.

Being morally pure will not happen without strong determination and discipline. It has always been this way, but even more so today with the rise of technology and the availability of evil at our fingertips.

Sexual sins are not foreign to the church. In fact, they are not foreign to any people of any race. We cannot relax and let down our guard and suppose that our children will be safe from the evils of society and our humanity. We must show by example and teach our children and youth if we expect them to stay clean in this corrupt society. We cannot assume that if a person dresses a certain way, all is well on the inside. The story is not told fully by the outside. The Pharisees made the outside look good, while the inside was full of corruption. Jesus said, “Cleanse first the inside of the cup and platter that the outside may be clean also” (Matthew 23:26). We too should give primary attention to heart issues. When the heart is clean, then the outside will be able to be cleansed also.

I John 1:6 says, “if we say that we have fellowship with Him and walk in darkness (light on the outside and darkness on the inside), we lie and do not practice the truth.” Internal darkness will always destroy fellowship and kill relationships—every time.

This is intended to be a message of hope, not discouragement. If you have a hidden dark spot, confess it and get rid of it. You can be free! It is possible to be free from Satan's clutches and live an open, transparent life with joy in your soul. You don't need to go through life trying to hide the darkness of evil. Jesus wants to forgive and heal.

Satan is cruel. In John 10:10, Jesus said, “the devil wants to steal, kill, and destroy. He wants to steal your purity, kill your character, and destroy” all godly relationships. His interest is to break up your home, destroy your respect, and send you to hell. All the while, he is luring you through the lust of your flesh, with his sword drawn to bind and kill you.

Moral sin is so shameful and hard to admit. The natural thing is to try to hide when we do wrong. Children who learn to hide wrongdoing early in life naturally develop into youth who hide things from parents, schoolteachers, and ministers. This person will need to learn to be open and transparent, or the time will come when they will be hiding things from their companion. Hiding results is a double life and leads to more bondage and broken relationships. People who have closed doors in some corners of their lives will be possessive of their phones and unwilling to share their passwords with a trusted partner. It seems we easily forget how futile it is to hide from God. Hebrews 4:13 says, “Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom (we will give account to).” How can we be so naive and foolish to think we can hide anything from God? Or take it a step further: Why would we want to hide something from Him? Numbers 32:23 is still very true, saying, “Be sure your sin will find you out.” God loves you too much to let you keep hiding what needs to be brought out and forgiven.

Sexual sins are also extremely deceptive. It usually happens the way James described it in chapter one. We are enticed, drawn away, pulled like a magnet off-center, feel a surge of desire, make sure no one is looking, and our tracks are covered, step closer to the forbidden, feel more desire, and begin very quickly to lose reasoning and sound thinking, not able to calculate consequences much like an intoxicated person, then James 1:15 happens: “Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death” Verse 16 says, “Do not (be deceived) my beloved brethren.”

James would tell us not to lust after what isn't ours, not even a hint. The Bible tells us to flee three things. One of these is fornication, which can be broadened to all sexual sins. Don't dabble with it; don't take a second look; get away from it! Replace those thoughts with upbuilding thoughts of God and His way. Sing an old hymn; thankfully we can't think of two things at once. Whatever it takes, flee from that lustful desire. It will take you farther than you want to go and cost more than you want to pay. Run the tape to the end and ask yourself, if I follow what I am being tempted for, will I have what I want? Satan always promises pleasure, but then delivers pain. Remember, Satan has never invented a pleasure; he only takes what God made to be pure and good, perverts it, and offers it back in its perverted form. Remember, Satan's sword is drawn to kill at this point. Flee evil desires!

Don’t follow your lust. Pornography is extremely addictive and has ensnared many a person. Promise Keepers said 65% of men in their survey were addicted. Porn addiction is like alcohol or drugs. They tell us that the brain is calling for endorphins to be poured into it, whether from addiction to alcohol, drugs, or porn. I emphasize again that the men and women who make it to victory will be those who, like Daniel of old, purpose in their hearts, not to defile themselves.

This subject is also for our sisters, and a few questions seem appropriate. What inside your life is neatly tucked away and hidden? Have life's disappointments caused an emptiness that makes taking an 'emotional Tylenol' make you feel better for a short while? Is your emotional connection secure where God has planned it to be?

Young girls should be taught to develop a healthy reserve with men. Not with a haughty attitude and never a smile, but also not too free in relating to young men. Our society is geared exactly the opposite, and from kindergarten on, boys and girls are being teased about special friendships. As a result, children grow up with little to no reserve. Socializing in messaging between genders should be avoided outside of family relationships. This will develop a habit in youth that will one day need to be broken if they expect to live an open, transparent life with a spouse. Think of it this way: would you want your spouse to socialize with the opposite gender on social media?

Sisters, be careful what books you read. Romance novels deaden the desire for the Word of God and give unrealistic expectations of married life. These books give the idea that the right man somewhere would be your key to fulfillment and happiness in life. Only Jesus can fill the hole that sin has brought to every human being today. No man or woman will ever be able to give the security and tranquility of the soul that we all want so badly. This hurt in the heart will never be quenched by Band-Aids or pain relievers. They help only for a moment, and when they wear off, the cry of the heart is even louder. Unwholesome books deaden a taste for the things of God, and instead create a craving for junk food and pain relievers.

Another concern to the sisters is the amount of time you spend online. There is no end to feeding the craving for finery, uniqueness, charm, and beauty. Don't let these things be the drive of your life as they will never cry out 'enough' and will do nothing to satisfy the soul or point your children in the right direction. Consider the amount of time you spend hosting parties. Over the years, I have seen names come and go of business opportunities and products that one must have. But alas, in a few years, we cannot even remember those names and all the while the children were growing and by now are adults. Consider the real needs in your life and your responsibilities, and then decide which will bring eternal investments. Women with children need to limit hobbies they so much enjoy because, at this moment, they are blessed with children who have never-dying souls and time with them is an eternal investment. Remember that your husband and children are far more worthy of your time than spending hours at another party.

How can we live a morally pure life?

Be Humble. James 5 says, “Confess your faults one to another that ye may be healed.” It takes humility and brokenness to acknowledge our needs, but brokenness is the key to victory. I Peter 5:5 tells us that God gives grace to the humble. One of the most comprehensive definitions of grace is unmerited divine assistance given to humans for regeneration and sanctification. Regeneration is 'redeeming grace,' and sanctification is 'transforming grace.' The truth of this is that God gives 'transforming grace' to the humble. This grace changes us from the inside out making us holy. This aspect of grace must be desired and sought after as much as redeeming grace was when God saved us. This is probably the single most important step in overcoming addictions of any kind. Be humble enough to make it a daily prayer to God for His transforming grace. Jesus taught in Matthew 23:26, where He said, "First clean the inside of the cup, so that the outside may be clean also."

Be Honest. Examine your thoughts, actions, temptations, the things you struggle with, anger, lust, pride, bitterness, etc. Are you as spiritual as you portray yourself to be on the outside? Strip the veneer and admit the need for help.

Be transparent. Romans 2:16 tells of the day when God will judge the secrets of men. We are so foolish to think we can hide evil. We can hide for a while, but someday our actions will stand naked before an all-knowing God. Why would we try to hide something now? Those hidden things can be sent before to judgment, and a guilt-free life can be a reality today. Be transparent; it must be a working goal.

Tell yourself the truth. When you are tempted, consider the end of your lustful desire. Will you get what you want? Will this craving be satisfied, or will it only crave more? If you saw your brother doing what you are going after, how would it look? How will it look thirty years down the road if you follow your evil desire? Will it bring joy or sorrow? Will it be a help to someone, or will someone else be scared? Tell yourself the truth before you become intoxicated and unable to make rational judgments.

Teach your eyes to bounce. You can't help what you look at the first time, but you can control what you look at twice. Make it a practice till it becomes a habit to turn your eyes in a different direction whenever you see a sight that leads to impure thoughts.

Teaching our children. This should be heavy on our hearts from early childhood. If we don’t teach our children that God made us in the image of Himself, which needs to be kept pure, someone else will teach them to be secretive and make them feel impure. Stay close to your children and teach them as they mature.

Keep your emotions. This is a safety in our corrupt society. The further you get from this, the more vulnerable you will be to corruption. Keep your spouse first in life, the one you share with and are tied to emotionally.

Flee lust and fornication. Run from it! These cravings are addictions that must be broken. Remember, what you feed grows, and what you starve dies. These addictions can be broken, but you will need to feed the relationships that God has given and starve the hurtful ones.

God has made us in a way that when we love the things He loves, our heart still has room to love more. No matter how many children, grandchildren, or godly friends we have, our hearts still have room to love more. But the moment we start to love what God has forbidden, it begins to replace and destroy all other love, filling our hearts with emptiness, pain, and loneliness, which leads to a bitter end.

Many a man has come to his senses and seen the utter foolishness of the path he took. Some tried to hide impure conduct and were successful until late in life. Others kept it hidden till after they were gone. A question to ponder, Is it worth it? Of course, the answer is a resounding NO!

How wonderful to live an open life free of guilt and have peace with God and the assurance of sins forgiven, so that one day we will be taken out of this evil world and ushered into the presence of our Holy God.

Two forces lie within my breast,
The one I love, the one I hate.
But the one I feed will dominate.

—The author’s dad

The more honestly I name
what is true about myself,
The less I need to hide and defend,
and posture and pretend.

—Dan Allender

Мораль касается того, что правильно и что неправильно в поведении. Чистота — это свобода от моральной вины или проступка, отмеченная целомудрием, которое является личной целостностью. Чистота не содержит ничего того, что туда не принадлежит. Как подсказывает заголовок, эта статья будет о том, чтобы поступать правильно и быть свободным от моральной вины и проступков, жить жизнью целостности и хранить свою внутренность и наружность свободными от всего того, что туда не должно принадлежать.

Заметьте, что Писание говорит о чистоте. “Blessed are the pure in heart” (Matthew 5:8). “That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere (pure) and without offense till the day of Christ” (Philippians 1:10). “Think on things that are pure” (Philippians 4:8). “Keep thyself pure” (1Timothy 5:22). Откровение 19 говорит: “The pure in heart shall see God.” Псалом 24:3-4 спрашивает: “Who shall see God?” Ответ: “he that hath clean hands and a pure heart.” Другими словами, те люди, которые чисты внутри и снаружи, увидят Бога и войдут в Его присутствие.

Быть морально чистым не произойдёт без сильной решимости и дисциплины. Так было всегда, но сегодня это ещё более актуально из-за развития технологий и доступности зла у нас под рукой.

Сексуальные грехи не чужды церкви. На самом деле они не чужды никакому народу любой расы. Мы не можем расслабляться и опускать бдительность, полагая, что наши дети будут в безопасности от зол общества и нашей человечности. Мы должны подавать пример и учить наших детей и молодёжь, если надеемся, что они сохранят чистоту в этом развращённом обществе. Нельзя предполагать, что если человек одевается определённым образом, то внутри у него всё в порядке. Внешность не рассказывает всей истории. Фарисеи делали внешний вид хорошим, тогда как внутри было полно развращённости. Иисус сказал: “Cleanse first the inside of the cup and platter that the outside may be clean also” (Matthew 23:26). Мы тоже должны уделять первоочередное внимание вопросам сердца. Когда сердце чисто, тогда и внешность можно будет очистить.

I John 1:6 says, “if we say that we have fellowship with Him and walk in darkness (light on the outside and darkness on the inside), we lie and do not practice the truth.” Внутренняя тьма всегда разрушит общение и погубит отношения — каждый раз.

Это должно быть посланием надежды, а не уныния. Если у вас есть скрытое тёмное место, признайте это и избавьтесь от него. Вы можете быть свободны! Возможно быть свободным от когтей сатаны и жить открытой, прозрачной жизнью с радостью в душе. Вам не нужно проходить через жизнь, пытаясь скрыть тьму зла. Иисус хочет прощать и исцелять.

Сатана жесток. В John 10:10 Иисус сказал: “the devil wants to steal, kill, and destroy. He wants to steal your purity, kill your character, and destroy” все благочестивые отношения. Его цель — разрушить ваш дом, уничтожить ваше уважение и послать вас в ад. Всё это время он соблазняет вас через похоть плоти, с обнажённым мечом, чтобы связать и убить вас.

Моральный грех так постыден и тяжело признать. Естественная реакция — пытаться скрыть, когда мы поступаем неправильно. Дети, которые учатся скрывать плохие поступки с раннего возраста, естественно вырастают в подростков, которые скрывают вещи от родителей, учителей и служителей. Такому человеку придётся научиться быть открытым и прозрачным, иначе наступит время, когда он станет скрывать вещи от своего спутника жизни. Сокрытие ведёт к двойной жизни и порождает ещё большее рабство и разрушенные отношения. Люди, у которых в некоторых уголках жизни закрыты двери, будут собственнически относиться к своим телефонам и не захотят делиться паролями с доверенным партнёром. Кажется, мы легко забываем, насколько тщетно скрываться от Бога. Hebrews 4:13 says, “Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom (we will give account to).” Как мы можем быть настолько наивными и глупыми, чтобы думать, что можем что‑то скрыть от Бога? Или пойти дальше: зачем нам что‑то скрывать от Него? Numbers 32:23 по‑прежнему верно говорит: “Be sure your sin will find you out.” Бог любит вас слишком сильно, чтобы позволить вам продолжать скрывать то, что должно быть выведено наружу и прощено.

Сексуальные грехи также чрезвычайно обманчивы. Обычно это происходит так, как описал Иаков в первой главе. Нас соблазняют, уводят в сторону, тянут как магнит с центра, мы чувствуем прилив желания, убеждаемся, что никто не смотрит, маскируем следы, делаем шаг ближе к запретному, чувствуем ещё больше желания и очень быстро начинаем терять рассудок и здравое мышление, неспособны подсчитать последствия подобно пьянице, затем происходит James 1:15: “Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death” Стих 16 говорит: “Do not (be deceived) my beloved brethren.”

Иаков сказал бы нам не желать того, что нам не принадлежит, даже намёком. Библия говорит убегать от трёх вещей. Одна из них — дошедшая до расширенного понятия блуд и все сексуальные грехи. Не балуйтесь с этим; не оглядывайтесь во второй раз; уходите от этого! Замените эти мысли возвышающими мыслями о Боге и Его пути. Спойте старый гимн; слава Богу, мы не можем думать о двух вещах одновременно. Что бы ни требовалось, бежите от похотливого желания. Оно унесёт вас дальше, чем вы хотите пойти, и будет стоить дороже, чем вы хотите заплатить. Прокрутите плёнку до конца и спросите себя: если я поддамся искушению, получу ли я то, чего хочу? Сатана всегда обещает удовольствие, но приносит боль. Помните, сатана никогда не изобретал наслаждение; он только берет то, что Бог создал чистым и добрым, исковеркал это и предлагает обратно в искажённом виде. Помните, меч сатаны обнажён, чтобы убить в этот момент. Бегите от злых желаний!

Не следуйте за своей похотью. Порнография чрезвычайно вызывающе вызывает зависимость и поймала многих людей. По данным Promise Keepers, 65% мужчин в их опросе были зависимы. Зависимость от порно похожа на алкоголь или наркотики. Говорят, что мозг требует эндорфинов, чтобы были выработаны ощущения удовольствия — будь то из зависимости от алкоголя, наркотиков или порно. Я снова подчёркиваю, что мужчины и женщины, которые придут к победе, будут те, кто, как древний Даниил, решают в сердце не осквернять себя.

Эта тема также адресована нашим сёстрам, и здесь уместны несколько вопросов. Что внутри вашей жизни аккуратно спрятано и скрыто? Привели ли жизненные разочарования к пустоте, из‑за которой «эмоциональный тайленол» даёт кратковременное облегчение? Надёжна ли ваша эмоциональная связь там, где Бог предусмотрел её быть?

Молодых девушек следует учить развивать здоровую сдержанность с мужчинами. Не в надменной манере и не запретительной улыбке, но и не чрезмерно свободно в общении с молодыми мужчинами. Наше общество настроено ровно наоборот, и уже в детском саду мальчиков и девочек дразнят по поводу особых дружб. В результате дети вырастают с малой или нулевой сдержанностью. Общение через сообщения между полами следует избегать вне семейных отношений. Это выработает у молодёжи привычку, которую однажды придётся ломать, если они рассчитывают жить открытой, прозрачной жизнью со своим супругом. Подумайте так: захотели бы вы, чтобы ваш супруг общался с представителями противоположного пола в социальных сетях?

Сёстры, будьте осторожны с тем, какие книги вы читаете. Романы о любви притупляют желание к Слову Божьему и создают нереалистичные ожидания семейной жизни. Эти книги внушают мысль о том, что правильный мужчина где‑то станет ключом к вашему исполнению и счастью в жизни. Только Иисус может заполнить ту пустоту, которую грех принес в каждого человека сегодня. Ни один мужчина или женщина не смогут дать ту безопасность и спокойствие души, которых мы так сильно хотим. Эта боль в сердце никогда не будет утолена пластырями или обезболивающими. Они помогут лишь на мгновение, а когда эффект проходит, крик сердца становится ещё громче. Нечистые книги притупляют вкус к вещам Божьим и порождают жажду еды низкого качества и обезболивающих.

Ещё одна забота для сестер — количество времени, которое вы проводите в сети. Нет предела питанию тяги к изыскам, уникальности, обаянию и красоте. Не позволяйте этим вещам управлять вашей жизнью, потому что они никогда не скажут «достаточно» и ничего не сделают, чтобы насытить душу или направить ваших детей в правильную сторону. Подумайте, сколько времени вы тратите на приёмы и вечеринки. Годы идут, я видел, как имена бизнес‑возможностей и товаров приходят и уходят, якобы «обязательных к приобретению». Но увы, через несколько лет мы и не вспомним этих названий, а дети росли и теперь уже взрослые. Оцените реальные потребности в вашей жизни и ваши обязанности, а затем решите, какие из них принесут вечные инвестиции. Женщинам с детьми нужно ограничивать хобби, которые им так нравятся, потому что сейчас они благословлены детьми с бессмертными душами, и время с ними — это вечная инвестиция. Помните, что ваш муж и дети стоят куда более достойно вашего времени, чем проводить часы на ещё одной вечеринке.

Will it be a help to someone, or will someone else be scared? Tell yourself the truth before you become intoxicated and unable to make rational judgments.

Teach your eyes to bounce. You can't help what you look at the first time, but you can control what you look at twice. Make it a practice till it becomes a habit to turn your eyes in a different direction whenever you see a sight that leads to impure thoughts.

Teaching our children. This should be heavy on our hearts from early childhood. If we don’t teach our children that God made us in the image of Himself, which needs to be kept pure, someone else will teach them to be secretive and make them feel impure. Stay close to your children and teach them as they mature.

Keep your emotions. This is a safety in our corrupt society. The further you get from this, the more vulnerable you will be to corruption. Keep your spouse first in life, the one you share with and are tied to emotionally.

Flee lust and fornication. Run from it! These cravings are addictions that must be broken. Remember, what you feed grows, and what you starve dies. These addictions can be broken, but you will need to feed the relationships that God has given and starve the hurtful ones.

God has made us in a way that when we love the things He loves, our heart still has room to love more. No matter how many children, grandchildren, or godly friends we have, our hearts still have room to love more. But the moment we start to love what God has forbidden, it begins to replace and destroy all other love, filling our hearts with emptiness, pain, and loneliness, which leads to a bitter end.

Many a man has come to his senses and seen the utter foolishness of the path he took. Some tried to hide impure conduct and were successful until late in life. Others kept it hidden till after they were gone. A question to ponder, Is it worth it? Of course, the answer is a resounding NO!

How wonderful to live an open life free of guilt and have peace with God and the assurance of sins forgiven, so that one day we will be taken out of this evil world and ushered into the presence of our Holy God.

Two forces lie within my breast,
The one I love, the one I hate.
But the one I feed will dominate.

—The author’s dad

The more honestly I name
what is true about myself,
The less I need to hide and defend,
and posture and pretend.

—Dan Allender

Spring is my favorite time of the year. Everything is new. Hyacinths are trying their noble best to poke their buds through the cold constraint of the winter-bound earth. Migrating waterfowl bring new sounds as they honk and quack their way to their final nesting places. This year the spring peepers in our area were “winter peepers” as they feebly squeaked their greetings to the arriving spring in mid-February. Tree buds are swelling, waiting to burst forth in full glory.

Oh, the magnificence of God’s nature joining forces to proclaim the glory of new life. Surely it must have been during this exuberant time of the year when the Psalmist wrote, “Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity” (Psalms 98:8-9). This display of new life springing from the earth is a beautiful representation of new life found in Christ Jesus. The wonders of the newness of life springing from the deadness of sin cannot be fully displayed by even the best show of God’s creation. It can only be experienced within the soul.

As I write this, I am flying 35,000 feet over the sub-Saharan desert land of Chad and Niger. The stark contrast between the landscape described in the previous paragraphs and the parched desert land hurrying by six miles below me is nearly beyond my comprehension. The dry earth begs for rain as livestock scrounge for anything green to fulfill their appetite. The vast dryness loudly proclaims a reminder of the millions of parched souls who have never heard of the “well of water springing up into everlasting life” (John 4:14). Millions who never experienced Christ the fountain as described in the Hymn History article in this issue:

Oh! Christ He is the foutain,
The deep sweet well of Love!
The streams on earth I’ve tasted,
More deep I’ll drink above:
There, to an ocean fullness,
His mercy doth expand,
And glory—glory dwelleth
In Immanuel’s land.

At times a yearning stirs in my heart to live the relaxed, relational lifestyle experienced in these impoverished tribal communities. Family and friends are more important than calendars and commitments. As we read in the Sister to Sister article, commitments and busyness can bring us to the overload point when we feel we cannot handle anything more. Read more to learn how to take practical steps to avoid that breaking point.

Most people in this area are Muslims. As I write this, Muslims are in the middle of Ramadan, a month-long season of fasting. They fast from food and water every day from dawn to dusk, even though daytime temperatures exceed 110 degrees. Their rigorous fasting, along with stopping their work to pray many times a day, is driven by a fervent desire to seek forgiveness of sins and obtain enough merit to enter heaven. If they only knew that true grace and mercy comes from God through the salvation of his Son, Jesus Christ. Our works can never bring us into right standing with God. The writer of the article “How to Increase Your Faith” clearly points this out “Faith is one of the basic ingredients in getting right with God. We come into the Christian life (and receive the forgiveness of sins) through faith. . . We abandon all hope for saving ourselves by our own abilities, and instead, we put complete trust in Jesus Christ for our eternal safety.”

As we plant our gardens and watch the trees burst forth in bloom, let us be reminded of the words of the prophet Isaiah, “For as the earth bringeth forth her bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations” (Isaiah 61:11).

Blessings to all,

Edward Martin

봄은 내가 가장 좋아하는 계절입니다. 모든 것이 새롭습니다. 히아신스는 겨울의 얼어붙은 대지의 제약을 뚫고 고개를 내밀기 위해 최선을 다하고 있습니다. 철새들은 마지막 둥지로 날아가며 끼익거리고 꽥꽥거리는 새로운 소리를 전해 옵니다. 올해 우리 지역의 봄개구리들은 2월 중순에 도착하는 봄에게 힘겹게 인사를 전하는 ‘겨울의 봄개구리’였습니다. 나무의 꽃봉오리는 부풀어 오르며 화려하게 터져 나오기를 기다리고 있습니다.

오, 새 생명을 선포하기 위해 연합하는 하나님의 창조의 장엄함이여. 시편 기자가 이 활기찬 계절에 이렇게 썼음이 분명합니다. “Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity” (Psalms 98:8-9). 땅에서 솟아나는 이 새 생명의 광경은 그리스도 예수 안에서 발견되는 새 생명의 아름다운 상징입니다. 죄의 죽음에서 솟아나는 삶의 새로움이 만들어내는 경이로움은 하나님의 창조가 아무리 훌륭히 드러나더라도 온전히 보여줄 수 없습니다. 그것은 오직 영혼 안에서 경험될 수 있습니다.

이 글을 쓰는 지금, 나는 사하라 이남의 차드와 니제르 땅 위 35,000피트 상공을 비행하고 있습니다. 앞 문단에서 묘사한 풍경과 아래 6마일(약 9.7km) 아래로 급히 지나가는 메마른 사막 지대 사이의 현저한 대조는 거의 이해하기 어려울 지경입니다. 말라 버린 땅은 비를 애절히 갈구하고 가축들은 배를 채우기 위해 푸른 것을 찾아 허겁지겁 뒤지며 돌아다닙니다. 이 광대한 건조함은 “영생에 이르게 하는 샘”(John 4:14)에 대해 결코 들어보지 못한 수백만의 목마른 영혼들을 크게 상기시켜 줍니다. 이 호수 같은 근원이자 샘이신 그리스도를 결코 경험해 보지 못한 수백만의 사람들—이번 호의 Hymn History(찬송가 역사) 기사에서 묘사된 대로—이 있습니다:

Oh! Christ He is the foutain,
The deep sweet well of Love!
The streams on earth I’ve tasted,
More deep I’ll drink above:
There, to an ocean fullness,
His mercy doth expand,
And glory—glory dwelleth
In Immanuel’s land.

때때로 가난한 부족 공동체에서 경험하는 느긋하고 관계 중심의 삶을 살고 싶은 갈망이 내 마음에 일어납니다. 가족과 친구는 달력과 일정보다 더 중요합니다. Sister to Sister(자매에게) 기사에서 읽을 수 있듯이, 약속과 분주함은 우리가 더 이상 감당할 수 없다고 느끼게 되는 과부하 지점으로 우리를 몰아갈 수 있습니다. 그 임계점에 이르지 않도록 피하는 실질적인 방법을 더 읽고 배워보십시오.

이 지역 대부분의 사람들은 무슬림입니다. 이 글을 쓰는 동안 무슬림들은 단식의 한 달인 라마단의 한가운데에 있습니다. 그들은 낮이 틀 때부터 해가 질 때까지 음식과 물을 금식합니다. 낮 기온이 110도(화씨)를 넘기도 하는데도 말입니다. 그들의 엄격한 금식과 낮 동안 여러 번 기도를 위해 일을 멈추는 행위는 죄 사함을 구하고 천국에 들어갈 자격을 얻기 위한 공로를 쌓으려는 열렬한 욕구에서 비롯됩니다. 그들이 만일 참된 은혜와 자비가 하나님의 아들 예수 그리스도를 통한 구원에서 온다는 것을 알기만 한다면 얼마나 좋을까요. 우리의 행위로는 결코 하나님과 올바른 관계에 이를 수 없습니다. “How to Increase Your Faith”(믿음을 증가시키는 방법)라는 글의 필자는 분명히 이렇게 지적합니다. “Faith is one of the basic ingredients in getting right with God. We come into the Christian life (and receive the forgiveness of sins) through faith. . . We abandon all hope for saving ourselves by our own abilities, and instead, we put complete trust in Jesus Christ for our eternal safety.”

우리가 정원을 심고 나무들이 꽃피우는 것을 바라볼 때, 선지자 이사야의 말씀을 기억합시다. “For as the earth bringeth forth her bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations” (Isaiah 61:11).

모든 분들에게 축복이 있기를,

Edward Martin
